title: In Capitals (None in the Source)
summary: A monumental inscription set entirely in capitals that are in no part of the page — copy it and you carry off only lowercase.
mechanism: CSS text-transform:uppercase renders monumental capitals absent from the DOM text and dropped by Selection/clipboard, a reversible one-line 'carving' verified live.
references: Horace, Odes III.30 (exegi monumentum aere perennius), 23 BC
Trajan's Column / Roman monumental capitals (capitalis monumentalis)
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
net.art source-vs-render tradition (y-a-v-a: Silencio, La Disparition)
